title: AccessWayCampusEdgesTemplate
description: Canonical template for importing surveyed real-world campus edges into ACCESSWAY AI (Source of truth: ACCESSWAY_AI_M9_Project_Documentation.docx)

stairs_count.description: Number of steps (0 for step-free paths; must be > 0 if path_type is 'stairs')

slope_percent.description: Incline gradient percentage (e.g. 4.5% for gentle ramp, max 8.33% for ADA)

clear_width_cm.description: Minimum corridor or door clear width in centimeters (min 90cm for standard wheelchairs)

wheelchair_accessible.description: Verified wheelchair accessibility. NULL indicates unverified and is NEVER included in step-free routes.

tactile_guidance.description: True if tactile ground paving or continuous handrail is present

landmark_instruction.description: Spoken turn-by-turn instruction referencing physical cues
